visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length brown hair wearing a beige ribbed long-sleeved top holds a large white plastic bag featuring a gorilla illustration and Japanese text. She is indoors, positioned in front of a window with horizontal blinds and a warm lamp reflecting in the background. (2) Close-up shots of the packaging highlight the brand name and various product details in Japanese. The woman’s hands are visible as she rotates the bag to show pink and purple product variations printed on the corner. (3) The woman is now sitting on a white hotel bed, opening the package. The background includes a dark wood headboard and a modern bedside table. She pulls out a grey fabric wrap-around massager and its accompanying black power adapter. (4) Close-up detail of the grey massager resting on the bed. It has an integrated control panel with three rectangular buttons: power, '+', and '-'. Black cables are coiled next to the device. (5) A hand is shown plugging the AC adapter into a wall socket located on a control panel above the nightstand. The table holds a digital alarm clock and a small package of earplugs. (6) The woman wraps the grey fabric around her bare calf while seated on the white bed linens. She looks at the camera, explaining the setup while the device's control panel displays blue and green LED lights. (7) Close-up of the massager tightly wrapped around her leg. The fabric physically contracts and relaxes as it inflates. The woman points at the leg, displaying expressions of surprise and slight discomfort as the pressure increases. (8) A hand belonging to an off-screen person briefly enters the frame to touch the massager on her leg while she continues to describe the physical sensation of the massage.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a bright, energetic female voice speaking Mandarin over an upbeat acoustic guitar and drum rhythm. The vocal tone is friendly and high-arousal. (2) A loud, sharp rustling sound occurs as the female speaker handles a plastic bag. The background music remains constant in the mix. (3) The female voice explains the purchase while more continuous plastic crinkling and shifting sounds are heard as she unpackages the item. (4) A distinct metallic 'click' sound is heard as a power adapter is pushed into a wall socket. The music continues without interruption. (5) Sounds of fabric friction and Velcro tearing accompany the woman as she describes fitting the massager to her leg. (6) A low-frequency mechanical air-pump hum and intermittent pneumatic pressure release sounds (whooshes) begin as the device operates. (7) A secondary male voice enters with a calm, curious tone. The female speaker responds with a rising pitch contour, expressing surprise and excitement at the intensity of the device. (8) The pneumatic pumping and fabric stretching sounds continue rhythmically until the end, accompanied by the female's high-arousal reactions and laughter.
